On the English‑German and English‑French WMT'14 translation tasks, our method accomplishes improvements of 0.63 and 0.85 BLEU, respectively. ... We further report improvements of 0.92% in accuracy and 2.13 points in perplexity on the subject‑verb agreement and language modeling tasks, respectively.
All translation tasks were evaluated against their respective newstest2014 test sets, in case-sensitive tokenized BLEU.
